# Synthetic QMF and fit numerical checkpoints

Internal test-only numerical vectors, not production inputs or independent/native qualification. INPUT-ONLY.json and approved providers are inputs. EXPECTED.json is assertion-only: never read it to select or calculate an encoded result. No research code, import paths, original source or binary is delivered.

Input starts at current unweighted complex QMF24 and explicit control/state boundary, not PCM or a second receiver. Three generations concatenate previous24 with current24. Previous target/carrier windows, temporal/geometry and control states start at the existing selected cold contracts. Clip128 is an explicit fixture value, not a new producer/owner. Production must still consume same-generation F04/J05 results.

## Complete deterministic recipe

For each carrier c=0..4, slot s=0..23, bin b=0..63, k is c except k=0 for c=1,b=0. Let bit(x,k)=(x>>k)&1. Real is R32(a*(1+(b mod3)/4)*(-1)^bit(s,k)); imaginary is R32((a/2)*(-1)^bit(s+1,(k+1)mod5)). Here a=1/16. These exact binary-rational operations have no trigonometry or RNG.

Object o uses carrier A=o mod5 and Z=(o+2)mod5. Its mixing coefficients by o mod3 are (3/4,0), (3/4,1/2), (1/2,-1/4). For each real/imag component, target is R32(R32(R32(alpha*A)+R32(beta*Z))*scale). Scale is four only at generation1, object0, slots>=12, otherwise one. Keep the previous generation's current24 as the next previous24.

Controls row0 is six-F32 [0,0,0,1,0,0]. For each object row o+1, set the carrier selections from INPUT-ONLY.target_control_carriers to one in lanes [0,1,2,4,5], other lanes zero. These are synthetic boundary controls, not ADM panner predictions. Advance the approved geometry/row state once per generation and use its eligibility; do not interpret initial eligibility as a permanent final-support mask if the approved search adds channels later.

Use the existing approved temporal, geometry, Gram/cross, signed solve, normalization, generated score, fit, quantization and Huffman contracts cited by TARGET-QMF-FIT-INTEGRATION-V1. Weight each complex component before products. Store normalized coefficients with one 1/16 scaling only. Full outputs are object/channel/band; sparse/index are object/band. The score provider is explicit; no generic libm fallback.

The selected representation has 15 present objects, downmix3, band5/fine1, one point, capacity372 and sequence0,0,1. Offsets consume the prior temporal segment according to the approved representation contract. The separate diagnostic capacity80 result is HELPER_ONLY and must not modify selected admission, rate or capacity.

## Expected format and comparison

EXPECTED.json has temporal before/after and trace, F32 weights, geometry/carry/row states/eligibility, complete weighted-row hashes, 540 Gram/cross/search records, storage-scale discriminators, full900 F32/sparse180 F32/index180 U16, quantized points and synthetic payloads. Compare the first differing stage before debugging whole payload bytes.

Fields named f32le_hex/u16le_hex or {hex:...} preserve their named raw encoding. {f64le:...} preserves a Python numeric value in binary64: values already rounded F32 are exactly that F32 value represented as F64, while score quantities retain F64. This wrapper does not authorize a change in arithmetic precision. The normalized empty-eligibility test label is a fixture outcome, not a native or product error-code mandate.

The coordinator independently verified 11 research payload hash/size bindings and reran the model checker in ordinary and optimized modes. Both recomputed all values before opening expected assertions and passed: three generations, 540 cells, 6263 explicit score calls, 549 nonzero stored values including90 negatives, exact tie-first behavior and empty-eligibility rejection. Provider copies match the existing approved math/functional/Huffman identities. These expected data were generated by the frozen model; recomputation is not independent algorithm agreement.

Real audio, PCM-to-QMF, full receiver, natural model/native coefficient comparison and full-song acceptance remain NOT_RUN. No new missing formula or production gate is introduced. Implementers should regenerate from the recipe using their own implementation, compare checkpoints, then continue production wiring. Test values and expected output must never be injected into production.
